title: Support standalone runners and complete app-folder reviews
summary: AL review skills now support standalone runners and folder-based app reviews by decoupling scheduling concerns and enabling parallel execution of independent review domains while maintaining deterministic result ordering.
key_points: Scheduling becomes an orchestrator concern, so isolated review leaves may run serially or concurrently
Sub-results must now be ordered deterministically regardless of completion order
Top-level severity counts are computed from deduplicated findings instead of summed leaf counts
folder-path is accepted as a complete current-state review scope by the standalone adapter, broad coordinator and every AL review leaf
New standalone-runner guide and README walk-up flow; architecture and partner guides moved under docs/
quote: Define scheduling as an orchestrator-owned concern and allow isolated leaves to run serially or concurrently.
